title: Sol Ring resolves only after the complete priority-pass sequence
plain_english: P0 casts the real frozen-Oracle Sol Ring from hand while holding priority.
The spell remains on the stack after casting and cannot be resolved by a direct resolve command.
P0 passes priority, then P1 passes priority without adding an object to the stack.
Only the completed all-player pass transition resolves Sol Ring and creates a new battlefield permanent object.
The cast action is no longer pending after resolution.

preconditions: Sol Ring is a physical card object in P0 hand
required_assertions: the stack object remains unchanged after each rejected direct-resolution attempt
the spell resolves only from the second consecutive priority pass
the original spell object is retired
a fresh Sol Ring permanent object is on the battlefield
